column1: World leaders agreed on a new framework to reduce carbon emissions by 50% before 2035 with binding G20 commitments.
The sudden market downturn was triggered by rising interest rates, disappointing tech earnings, and recession fears.
NASA's Artemis III mission landed astronauts on the lunar south pole, the first crewed Moon landing in over 50 years.
The EU passed comprehensive AI legislation requiring transparency for high-risk systems and banning public facial recognition.
Global investment in solar and wind energy reached $500 billion in 2025, surpassing fossil fuel spending for the third year.
A 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck central Turkey, displacing thousands and prompting international humanitarian aid responses.
The World Health Organization declared the end of the mpox public health emergency after global case counts dropped by 90%.
Major automakers announced plans to phase out internal combustion engines entirely by 2035 across European markets.
A bipartisan infrastructure bill allocated $120 billion for broadband expansion, targeting underserved rural communities.
Central banks across Asia cut interest rates in a coordinated move to stimulate slowing economic growth in the region.
